```{=latex}
\fontsize{7.8}{8.8}\selectfont
\begin{multicols}{2}
\raggedright
\begin{E}
\hd{Curve} $v=\sqrt{gr\frac{\tan\theta\pm\mu_s}{1\mp\mu_s\tan\theta}}$ ($+$ max, $-$ min). Flat: $v_{max}=\sqrt{\mu_s gr}$. No friction: $v=\sqrt{gr\tan\theta}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Loop} top barely ($N{=}0$): $v_t=\sqrt{gR}$; bottom min $v_b=\sqrt{5gR}$; launch $h=\tfrac52R$.
$v_t^2=v_b^2-4gR=2g(h-2R)$. $N_{top}=\frac{mv_t^2}{R}-mg$, $N_{bot}=\frac{mv_b^2}{R}+mg$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Energy} $E_i+E_{add}=E_f+E_{lost}$; $E_{lost}=\mu N d$; incline $N=mg\cos\theta$. Never through a collision.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Fall / coaster} (no friction) $v_f=\sqrt{v_i^2+2g(h_i-h_f)}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Halfpipe} $h_f=h_i+\frac{v_i^2}{2g}-n\mu L$ ($n$ = crossings of rough length $L$). Full crossings $=\lfloor h_i/\mu L\rfloor$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{One block on incline} ($\Delta x$ along slope)\par
Up: $v_f^2=v_i^2-2g\Delta x(\sin\theta+\mu\cos\theta)$\par
Down: $v_f^2=v_i^2+2g\Delta x(\sin\theta-\mu\cos\theta)$\par
Stop up: $\Delta x=\frac{v_i^2}{2g(\sin\theta+\mu\cos\theta)}$\par
Stop down: $\Delta x=\frac{v_i^2}{2g(\mu\cos\theta-\sin\theta)}$\par
$\sqrt{-}$ = stops first. Time: $t=\frac{2\Delta x}{v_i+v_f}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Spring} $\tfrac12kx^2=\tfrac12mv^2+mgh$. Stop a mass: $x=\sqrt{\frac{2mgh+mv_i^2}{k}}$; launch up $h=\frac{kx^2}{2mg}$ (from release pt); level $v=x\sqrt{k/m}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Power} $P=\frac{W}{t}=\frac{mgh}{t}=Fv$. Work $W=Fd\cos\phi$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Atwood / mass on pulley} ($m_1$ falls, $m_2$ rises; one mass: $m_2{=}0$)
$v_f^2=v_i^2+\frac{2gh(m_1-m_2)}{m_1+m_2+I/R^2}$, $a=\frac{(m_1-m_2)g}{m_1+m_2+I/R^2}$, $T=m_1(g-a)$.
$I/R^2$: massless $0$, disk $\tfrac12M$, ring $M$, given $kMR^2\to kM$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Incline + hanging mass + pulley} $v_f^2=v_i^2+\frac{2g\Delta x\,B}{m_1+m_2+I/R^2}$
($m_1$ on slope, $m_2$ hangs).\par
$m_2$ falls: $B=m_2-m_1\sin\theta-\mu m_1\cos\theta$\par
$m_1$ slides down: $B=m_1\sin\theta-m_2-\mu m_1\cos\theta$\par
Stops: $\Delta x=\frac{-(m_1+m_2+I/R^2)v_i^2}{2gB}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Projectile} $H=h_0+\frac{(v_0\sin\theta)^2}{2g}$, $t_{top}=\frac{v_0\sin\theta}{g}$.
\end{E}
\end{multicols}

\newpage

\begin{multicols}{2}
\raggedright
\begin{E}
\hd{Force from $\Delta p$} $F=\frac{m(v_f-v_i)}{t}$. Bounce back: $\frac{2mv}{t}$; stop: $\frac{mv}{t}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Stick (inelastic)} $v_f=\frac{m_1v_1+m_2v_2}{m_1+m_2}$; $\frac{K_f}{K_i}=\frac{(m_1+m_2)v_f^2}{m_1v_1^2+m_2v_2^2}$ (one at rest: $\frac{m_1}{m_1+m_2}$).
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Elastic} $v_{1f}=\frac{(m_1-m_2)v_{1i}+2m_2v_{2i}}{m_1+m_2}$, $v_{2f}=v_{1i}+v_{1f}-v_{2i}$.
Equal $m$, 2 at rest: $v_{1f}=0$, $v_{2f}=v_{1i}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Ballistic} $v=\frac{M+m}{m}\sqrt{2gh}$; $V=\frac{mv}{M+m}$, $h=\frac{V^2}{2g}$; $\frac{K_f}{K_i}=\frac{m}{M+m}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Rot. kinematics} $\omega_f=\omega_i+\alpha t$; $\Delta\theta=\frac{\omega_i+\omega_f}{2}t$; $\omega_f^2=\omega_i^2+2\alpha\Delta\theta$; $\Delta\theta=\omega_it+\tfrac12\alpha t^2$. Use the one without the quantity you lack.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{$I$ (center)} ring $MR^2$, disk $\tfrac12MR^2$, sphere $\tfrac25MR^2$, rod mid $\tfrac1{12}m\ell^2$, rod end $\tfrac13m\ell^2$, point $mr^2$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Parallel axis} $I=I_{cm}+md^2$, $d$ from CENTER. Rod, axis $a$ from end: $I=m[\frac{\ell^2}{12}+(\frac{\ell}{2}-a)^2]$. Disk about rim $\tfrac32MR^2$. Pieces add.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Torque} $v=R\omega$, $a=R\alpha$, $s=R\theta$. $\tau=rF\sin\phi=I\alpha$. Pulley: $RT=I\alpha\Rightarrow T=\frac{I}{R^2}a$. $K_{rot}=\tfrac12I\omega^2$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Rolling} $v=\sqrt{\frac{2gh}{1+I/mR^2}}$, $\omega=\frac{v}{R}$, $a=\frac{g\sin\theta}{1+I/mR^2}$.
Ring $\sqrt{gh}$, disk $\sqrt{\tfrac43gh}$, sphere $\sqrt{\tfrac{10}7gh}$, slide $\sqrt{2gh}$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Angular momentum} ($L_i=L_f$) $\omega_f=\frac{I_1\omega_1+I_2\omega_2\pm mvr}{I_1+I_2+I_{add}}$.
$\omega_2<0$ counter-rotating; $-mvr$ runs against rim; drop/step on: no $mvr$.
$I_{add}$: person $mr^2$, rod center$\to$edge $\tfrac13m\ell^2$, disk $\tfrac12mr^2$.
Walk in/out: $\omega_f=\frac{I_i}{I_f}\omega_i$; rim$\to$center $\omega_f=\frac{M+2m}{M}\omega_i$. $K=\tfrac12I\omega^2$.
\end{E}
\sep
\begin{E}
\hd{Pick the law} speed/height: energy; circle: $\Sigma F=\frac{mv^2}{r}$; hit: momentum; time: forces; spin change: $L_i=L_f$.
\end{E}
\end{multicols}
```
